slice: production: how the winning faceless story and explainer Shorts are made

counts.instagram: not listed: it needs the owner's logged-in browser

styles.name: 3D scene, the thing itself shown
styles.what: A 3D animation of the event or the mechanism itself. The best case is one unbroken shot with a camera that never rests (Zack D. Films); the cheap case is low-poly people in a small set (MagnatesMedia's two biggest Shorts).
styles.how_made: Rendered 3D (the look of a game engine or Blender) with an edited voice and many effects. Zack D. Films is photoreal with animated people; MagnatesMedia is flat-shaded low-poly without faces.

styles.name: Flat 2D animation
styles.what: Drawn or vector pictures that act out each sentence: Kurzgesagt's flat vector people and plates, cartoon history, doodles, stick figures, painted maps, one diagram.
styles.how_made: Vector animation (After Effects or similar), hard cuts every 3 s, long holds between moves.

styles.name: Footage documentary
styles.what: A narrator over stock, news and archive footage, a new shot every 1 to 2 s, key words or small captions. The form of the business-story channels themselves.
styles.how_made: An editor's timeline: found clips, a colour grade, a music bed as loud as the voice, glitch and zoom transitions.

A.name: 3D scene in one shot (Zack D. Films)

cuts.note: one continuous camera move through one scene; the only break found is a 0.97 s camera whip

A.frame0: the subject mid-frame in a mid shot, already doing the thing; the first two words on the caption line; no title, logo or header

captions.shadow: hard, 2 px right and 2 px down, #000000
captions.css: font:700 75px Tahoma; color:#fff; -webkit-text-stroke:4px #000; paint-order:stroke fill; text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000;

A.outro: the scene's end state; no end card, question or logo; the last word ends 0.85 to 0.9 s before the end

variant_low_poly.look: flat-shaded low-poly people without faces, a dim teal-grey shop with warm lamps, strong depth-of-field blur; one scene, a forward dolly reading as 21% a second

B.name: Flat vector animation (Kurzgesagt)

motion.camera: mostly none; a pull-out of 3.2 to 6.2% a second where there is one

B.frame0: the title, which is the first spoken sentence word for word, in two centred lines at about y 290 to 520 over the subject; held about 2 s

captions.font_note: a rounded geometric sans with a one-storey a; not among 84 candidates

B.look: flat vector shapes with soft gradients, saturated fills on deep violet (#230858, #2e055b); a tilted yellow label plate for every named thing
B.outro: the answer as a picture, or the opening figure again; no end card or logo

C.name: Footage documentary (Jake Tran; How Money Works where it says so)

cuts.how_money_works: cut figures are a floor: its early transitions are not scored by the counter

C.frame0: footage with no text; from 0.5 s the hook words arrive one or two at a time in a heavy condensed display face (not measured), each over about 0.12 s

captions.shadow: soft black all round, 8 to 18 px wide
captions.how_money_works: no running captions: name tags and one figure card

C.grade: Jake Tran: desaturated, crushed, pink-purple cast (#90797c, #b29eaa, #785957 over #161512); How Money Works: as found
C.outro: Jake Tran: the last words lead into the first line over the first shot (a loop); How Money Works: its logo for about the last second
